# Final Report Target Trajectories

This catalog lists the exact trajectory generators used by the final-report experiment suites. Procedural trajectories are regenerated in memory and are not stored as standalone NPZ files. Only the two targets derived from recorded commands are retained under `inputs/`.

Regenerate and validate this document with:

```bash
uv run --project exp/src --frozen python exp/src/trajectory_catalog.py \
  --check-report --output exp/src/TRAJECTORIES.md
```

|---|---|---:|
| `screening` | `study.screening_scenarios()` | 42 |
| `parameters` | `study.focused_scenarios()` | 11 |
| `driver` | `study.focused_scenarios()` | 11 |
| `symmetry` | `study.symmetry_scenarios()` | 25 |
| `chest` | `targeted_study.chest_scenarios()` | 14 |
| `braking` | `targeted_study.make_joint6_limit_scenario(..., angular_speed in [2, 4, 8, 12])` | 4 |

| `candidates` | `study.screening_scenarios()` | 42 |
| `frozen` | `run_experiments.frozen_benchmarks()` | 2 |
| `fast_retract_error_bound` | `run_experiments.accelerated_fast_retract_benchmark()` | 1 |
| `singularity_video` | `video_trajectory_study.make_deep_start_reach(...)` | 1 |
| `nullspace_sweep` | `run_experiments.frozen_benchmarks()[fast_retract]` | 1 |
| `nullspace_validation` | `study.focused_scenarios()` | 11 |

`boundary` is omitted because it contains 378 static joint-limit conditions, not Cartesian target trajectories.

## Unique Trajectories

The dynamic suites reference 70 unique sampled targets: 67 procedural, 2 frozen inputs, and 1 time-compressed frozen derivative.

Names encode the relevant generator parameters: `v` is linear speed in m/s, `w` is angular speed in rad/s, and `p`/`m` encode positive/negative decimal values. Exact parameter grids are defined by the suite entry points above.
